purpose: Teach: 吐き気/日本食/静寂/脱力/化合/矢先/在来/祭典

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、ぼく、車酔いで吐き気がしたの覚えてる?
lines.en: Sho, do you remember when I got car sick on the way there?
lines.style: Gentle, reaching back into shared memory. Soft curiosity — not testing him, but inviting him to join her in recalling something small and real between them.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お祖母ちゃんの日本食大好きだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really love Grandma's Japanese cooking.
lines.style: Bright, genuine enthusiasm. The simple certainty of a child naming something he knows he likes. No performance — just honest delight.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、夜の公園の静寂、神秘的ね
lines.en: Sho, there's something so peaceful about the park at night, isn't there?
lines.style: Quiet, almost dreamy. She's speaking half to him, half to herself. Slow pace. The voice of someone noticing beauty and wanting to hold it gently.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、運動会の後、脱力したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I totally crashed after sports day.
lines.style: Small, wry laugh underneath. Matter-of-fact about his own exhaustion. The dry observation of a child who notices his own limits and reports them without drama.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが化合物のお仕事してらっしゃるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your father works with chemical compounds, doesn't he?
lines.style: Thoughtful and careful. She's speaking about something grown-up — showing interest in his family with respect. Gentle, observant tone. Not prying, but genuinely curious.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お絵描きを始めた矢先、絵筆が折れちゃった
lines.en: Mei-sis, I just started drawing and my brush snapped.
lines.style: Wry, matter-of-fact frustration. The dry acceptance of small disasters. Delivered with a hint of dark humor — not complaining, just reporting the absurdity of bad timing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんが在来種のお米を作ってらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your grandfather grows native rice varieties, I hear.
lines.style: Admiring and warm. She's speaking about his family with genuine respect. Slow, unhurried. The voice of someone who finds quiet dignity in the work people do.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、地域の祭典に出たいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to go to the local festival.
lines.style: Direct and bright, with real conviction underneath. He's moved past mere enthusiasm — this is something he actually wants. Clear, unguarded, trusting her to hear him.
